scope: Accessibility enumeration and the stale-target defence in front of a press. No press was dispatched; every resolve used dryRun.

refusals.changedLabel: A different control is in that position now. Look at the application again.
refusals.changedRole: A different control is in that position now. Look at the application again.
refusals.movedControl: The control is no longer where it was. Look at the application again.
refusals.jarvisItself: Jarvis does not press its own controls.
refusals.unknownApplication: That application is no longer running.
refusals.enumeratingJarvis: Choose a running application other than Jarvis.
